new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/plain"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("plain")
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withBody("no quote, backtick or hash")
);

<?php

use MockServer\MockServerClient;
use MockServer\Expectation;

$client = new MockServerClient('localhost', <port>);

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{
  "httpRequest" : {
    "method" : "GET",
    "path" : "/plain"
  },
  "httpResponse" : {
    "statusCode" : 200,
    "reasonPhrase" : "OK",
    "body" : {
      "type" : "STRING",
      "string" : "no quote, backtick or hash",
      "rawBytes" : "bm8gcXVvdGUsIGJhY2t0aWNrIG9yIGhhc2g="
    }
  },
  "id" : "plain",
  "priority" : 0,
  "timeToLive" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  },
  "times" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  }
}
JSON, true)));

<?php

use MockServer\MockServerClient;
use MockServer\Expectation;

$client = new MockServerClient('localhost', <port>);

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{
  "httpRequest" : {
    "path" : "/json",
    "body" : {
      "type" : "JSON",
      "json" : {
        "text" : "ascii é ñ 中文 😀 quote \" backslash \\ tab \t newline \n crlf \r\n backtick ` hashes \"## end"
      }
    }
  },
  "httpResponse" : {
    "body" : {
      "type" : "BINARY",
      "base64Bytes" : "",
      "contentType" : "application/octet-stream"
    }
  },
  "id" : "json",
  "priority" : 0,
  "timeToLive" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  },
  "times" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  }
}
JSON, true)));

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/binary")
                .withBody(new Base64Converter().base64StringToBytes("")),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("binary")
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(201)
                .withBody("{\n  \"emoji\" : \"\uD83D\uDE00\",\n  \"tick\" : \"`\"\n}")
);
